caseNameFull: Ryan, Director, Arizona Department of Corrections v. Schad
judges: Application, Execution, Grant, Scadia, Stay, Vacate

opinions.text:
Application to vacate stay of execution *1223of sentence of death entered by the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit on March 1, 2013, presented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Justice Scadia and Justice Alito would grant the application to vacate the stay of execution.
